title: Powerball winning numbers 11/2/26: $803.9M jackpot up for grabs
text:
Powerball winning numbers 11/2/26: $803.9M jackpot up for grabs - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut PERSONAL FINANCE 
 Powerball winning numbers drawn for Monday's $803.9M jackpot 
 Tuesday, November 3, 2026 4:02AM Share Follow abc7NY on Google NEW YORK CITY (WABC) -- The winning numbers have been drawn for Monday night's Powerball jackpot worth an estimated $803.9 million.
 Monday's winning numbers were: 7, 29, 64, 23, 66, and Powerball of 23.
 Watch the Powerball drawing streamed here on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 p.m.
 The Powerball jackpot was last won on August 12, when a single ticket sold in Illinois captured a $1.04 billion grand prize. Since then, there have been 33 consecutive drawings without a jackpot winner, making Saturday's drawing the 34th in the current jackpot cycle.
 This also marks the first jackpot cycle in which players in the United Kingdom have contributed to the prize pool from the start of the run, with every ticket sold contributing equally to jackpot growth.
 The overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 24.9. The odds of winning the jackpot are 1 in 292.2 million. For more information, visit Powerball.com.
 Here is a look at the 10 largest U.S. jackpots that have been won and the states where the winning tickets were sold:
 1. $2.040 billion, Powerball, Nov. 7, 2022 (one ticket: California) 2. $1.817 billion, Powerball, Dec. 24, 2025 (one ticket: Cabot, Arkansas) 3. $1.787 billion, Powerball. Sept. 6, 2025 (two tickets: Missouri and Texas) 4. $1.765 billion, Powerball, Oct. 11, 2023 (one ticket: California) 5. $1.602 billion, Mega Millions, Aug. 8, 2023 (one ticket: Florida) 6. $1.586 billion, Powerball, Jan. 13, 2016 (three tickets: California, Florida and Tennessee) 7. $1.537 billion, Mega Millions, Oct. 23, 2018 (one ticket: South Carolina) 8. $1.348 billion, Mega Millions, Jan. 13, 2023 (one ticket: Maine) 9. $1.337 billion, Mega Millions, July 29, 2022 (one ticket: Illinois) 10. $1.326 billion, Powerball, April 6, 2024 (one ticket: Portland, Oregon)
 You can watch the New York State lottery drawings live daily at 2:30 p.m. and 10:30 p.m., and on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 8:15 p.m., on ABC 7 New York.
 Powerball drawings are also streamed here on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 p.m.
 Mega Millions drawings are streamed on Tuesday and Friday at 11:00 p.m.
 The New York Lottery remains North America's largest and most profitable Lottery, contributing $3.7 billion in Lottery Aid to Education for FY2022-2023 to support education in New York State.
 New York Lottery revenue is distributed to local school districts by the same statutory formula used to distribute other state aid to education. It takes into account both a school district's size and its income level; larger, lower-income school districts receive proportionately larger shares of lottery school funding.
 For more information about the New York lottery and to see lottery results, please visit nylottery.ny.gov. .
 New Yorkers struggling with a gambling addiction, or who know someone who is, can find help by calling the State's toll-free, confidential HOPEline at 1-877-8-HOPENY (1-877-846-7369) or by texting HOPENY (467369). Standard text rates may apply.
 (The Associated Press contributed to this report.)
